tests.title: Core operates identically with all extensions disabled
tests.setup: Create clean Core workspace; ensure extension_registry is entirely empty.
tests.action: Execute standard M1 E2E workflow (create stream, append record).
tests.oracle: Core completes operations with zero extension modules imported; implementation-independent sys.modules snapshot confirms absence.

tests.title: Core package import graph statically forbids extension imports
tests.setup: Install package with full M2 code.
tests.action: Use static AST traversal on all Core module entrypoints.
tests.oracle: No AST import node points to M2 Extension namespaces.

tests.title: Extension schemas are strictly prefixed against core tables
tests.setup: Load a valid mock extension containing a DB schema payload.
tests.oracle: Raw `sqlite3` PRAGMA table_info confirms all new tables start with 'ext_'; original core tables are exactly matched.

tests.title: Extension disable preserves tables and ignores legacy hooks
tests.setup: Enable extension, write data, then change state to DISABLED.
tests.action: Restart host and trigger hook event.
tests.oracle: Host boots, hook is ignored. Raw `sqlite3` confirms extension table data remains untouched.

tests.title: Concurrent enable/disable toggles are fenced via SQLite WAL
tests.setup: Spawn 2 multiprocessing.Process instances targeting the same extension toggle.
tests.action: Process A calls enable(); Process B calls disable().
tests.oracle: Strict serialization enforced by DB driver lock. Final state strictly matches the last committed transaction. DB integrity check passes.
tests.evidence: multiprocessing exit codes + raw sqlite3 PRAGMA integrity_check

tests.title: Manifest config validation strictly rejects unknown keys
tests.setup: Craft extension manifest containing undefined property 'rogue_flag'.
tests.action: Attempt to load and validate manifest.
tests.oracle: Draft202012 Validator throws strict failure. State enters FAILED immediately.

tests.title: Positive control for manifest validation
tests.setup: Craft exact perfect extension manifest.
tests.action: Attempt to load and validate manifest.
tests.oracle: Validation passes perfectly; state advances to VALIDATED.

tests.title: Rollback triggered automatically if extension migration crashes halfway
tests.setup: Mock os._exit(1) hook midway through an extension schema script.
tests.oracle: Process dies. Upon restart, raw `sqlite3` proves DB is in initial valid state; no torn table exists.
tests.evidence: OS exit code + SQLite raw query

tests.title: Idempotent enable call returns existing state safely
tests.setup: Extension is already in ENABLED state.
tests.oracle: No DB write occurs (tracked via SQLite total_changes). Request succeeds gracefully.

tests.title: Forbidden transition ENABLED directly to VALIDATED fails
tests.setup: Force extension into ENABLED state.
tests.action: Attempt API call mapped to VALIDATED transition.
tests.oracle: Throws ForbiddenTransitionError immediately without mutating state.

tests.title: Forbidden transition FAILED to ENABLED fails without validation
tests.setup: Force extension into FAILED state due to schema error.
tests.oracle: Throws ForbiddenTransitionError. Extension stays FAILED.

tests.title: Disabled state safely persists across hard process restart
tests.setup: Set extension to DISABLED.
tests.oracle: Registry initialization reads DB correctly; extension loads but remains explicitly DISABLED.

tests.title: Extension hook runtime exception does not crash Core host
tests.setup: Inject ZeroDivisionError inside an extension's registered callback.
tests.action: Trigger core event firing the callback.
tests.oracle: Core event finishes safely; exception is trapped, logged, and extension state enters FAILED.

tests.title: Missing dependency extension blocks enablement with terminal error
tests.setup: Manifest requires 'ext_auth' which is absent.
tests.oracle: Throws MissingDependencyError; state mapped to FAILED terminal disposition.

tests.title: Duplicate manifest registration of identical ID is rejected
tests.setup: Load extension ID 'ext_chat'.
tests.action: Attempt to load a different manifest also declaring ID 'ext_chat'.
tests.oracle: Throws RegistrationConflictError; original extension remains intact.

tests.title: Rebuilding extension registry clears internal memory cache safely
tests.setup: Load registry, warm up internal Python LRU caches.
tests.oracle: Registry garbage collects old modules; GC tracker proves memory is freed; state reads clean from DB.

tests.title: Concurrent read during migration blocks cleanly until commit
tests.setup: Process A starts 5-second migration script; Process B attempts to read registry.
tests.oracle: SQLite BusyTimeout correctly pauses Process B; B eventually reads fully updated state. No partial reads.
tests.evidence: Time delta check + multiprocessing exit codes

tests.title: Manifest missing strictly required properties fails validation
tests.setup: Create manifest omitting the required 'version' key.
tests.oracle: Fails JSONSchema validation with missing required property error.

tests.title: Null values for string typed properties explicitly rejected
tests.setup: Set manifest 'description' to JSON null.
tests.oracle: Fails JSONSchema validation strictly on type mismatch.

tests.title: Extension schema migration successfully handles ADD COLUMN
tests.setup: Deploy v1 of extension schema.
tests.action: Run v2 migration applying ADD COLUMN.
tests.oracle: Raw sqlite3 confirms column exists and old data retains NULL/default values intact.

tests.title: Extension DB operates on separate distinct connection schema
tests.setup: Load core DB and extension DB.
tests.oracle: Extension tables are logically separate from 'main' core tables (attached or isolated file).

tests.title: State transition DISCOVERED to FAILED succeeds on invalid manifest
tests.setup: Scan finds broken manifest folder.
tests.oracle: State moves strictly from DISCOVERED to FAILED.

tests.title: Extension host startup completes after Core stream init securely
tests.setup: Start full application server stack.
tests.oracle: Core dependencies initialize first; extension host binds afterward, proving architectural layering.

tests.title: Extension schema downgrade strictly throws explicit error
tests.setup: Migrate extension to v3.
tests.action: Attempt to load manifest demanding v2 migration.
tests.oracle: Throws DowngradeNotSupportedError; state aborts gracefully.

tests.title: Blob is fully durable on disk before Core Record reference append
tests.setup: Stage blob and mock the Core Record append function to crash immediately.
tests.oracle: System crashes. Upon restart, raw `os.stat` proves the blob exists fully durable on disk, but no DB record exists. Orphan cleanup will catch it.

tests.title: Crash injected between commit and metadata write leaves orphan safely
tests.setup: Hook os._exit(1) immediately after the atomic `os.rename` operation.
tests.oracle: Process dies. File exists at final digest path on disk. Metadata DB has no record. System restarts safely.

tests.title: Disk-full (ENOSPC) during stage leaves no corrupted commit
tests.setup: Mock os.write to throw IOError(ENOSPC) halfway through staging chunk writes.
tests.oracle: Commit fails explicitly. Partial temp file is aggressively removed. Final committed digest path `os.path.exists` is false.

tests.title: Partial copy/read interruption aborts staging securely
tests.setup: Stream input generator intentionally throws exception midway through sending payload.
tests.oracle: Pipeline traps error, cleans up `.tmp` staging file, and aborts before DIGESTED state.

tests.title: Path traversal attempts in artifact reference are strictly rejected
tests.setup: Craft malicious artifact reference with digest '../foo'.
tests.action: Attempt to resolve and open the artifact.
tests.oracle: System strictly rejects the request via regex/path boundary validation. File read never executes.

tests.title: Symlinks in payload or path are rejected as security violation
tests.setup: Create an OS symlink pointing outside the workspace and pass it as artifact source.
tests.oracle: os.path.islink validation catches symlink and throws SecurityBoundaryError.

tests.title: Windows junction and reparse points rejected securely
tests.setup: Create Windows junction point in the test payload.
tests.oracle: Windows specific `os.stat().st_file_attributes & stat.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT` detects and aborts.

tests.title: Unicode normalization collisions on Windows detected and rejected
tests.setup: Stage a file named with NFC unicode. Attempt to stage same content with NFD unicode equivalent.
tests.oracle: Digests are unique, but Windows FS might fold them. Implementation enforces strictly explicit ASCII hex digests mapping, preventing this entirely.

tests.title: Tampered blob read detects bit-flip mismatch explicitly
tests.setup: Commit a valid blob. Manually open file on disk and flip one byte.
tests.oracle: Implementation streams file through hashlib on read, detects mismatch with DB metadata, and throws ArtifactTamperedError immediately.

tests.title: Zero-byte overwrite of committed artifact detected securely
tests.setup: Commit a valid 5KB blob. Externally truncate file to 0 bytes on disk.
tests.oracle: Size check against metadata catches mismatch before full hash, throwing ArtifactTamperedError.
tests.evidence: os.stat size vs DB size assertion

tests.title: Huge file (>2GB) staging chunking prevents MemoryError (OOM)
tests.setup: Use synthetic sparse file or stream generator generating 2.1GB of data.
tests.oracle: Memory usage profile remains flat (<50MB). File commits successfully. Raw OS stat confirms 2.1GB size.

tests.title: Windows case-insensitive file system collision rejected securely
tests.setup: If digesting relied on names instead of pure hashes, collisions occur. Ensure strict SHA256 hex naming.
tests.oracle: Artifacts are named purely by lowercase SHA256 hex. Impossible to collide on case.

tests.title: Windows reserved device names (CON, NUL) strictly rejected
tests.setup: Pass 'CON' and 'NUL' as artifact reference names.
tests.oracle: Validation layer blocks reserved words before hitting OS layer.

tests.title: Long paths (>260 chars) on Windows handled gracefully
tests.setup: Construct workspace base path exactly 255 chars long.
tests.action: Stage and commit artifact (adding 64 char digest).
tests.oracle: System uses Windows `\\?\` long path prefix internally, completing successfully without OS limit crash.

tests.title: NUL byte in reference filename strictly rejected
tests.setup: Craft artifact reference containing '\x00'.
tests.oracle: Regex blocks NUL byte before OS throws ValueError.

tests.title: Concurrent staging of identical payload across 2 processes fenced cleanly
tests.setup: Spawn 2 multiprocessing.Process instances writing same bytes to ArtifactStore.
tests.oracle: Both generate unique `.tmp` suffixes (e.g. via mkstemp). Both successfully digest. Only one wins the atomic rename to final digest, the other ignores FileExistsError (idempotent).

tests.title: Idempotent commit of already existing artifact succeeds seamlessly
tests.setup: Artifact already committed and VERIFIED.
tests.oracle: System recognizes digest matches existing file. Bypasses rewrite, returning existing metadata.

tests.title: Read validation against raw hashlib output strictly matches
tests.setup: Commit a valid blob.
tests.action: Run raw Python `hashlib.sha256()` on the physical file.
tests.oracle: Raw hashlib output strictly equals the DB metadata digest. No implementation shortcut used.

tests.title: Read validation confirms OS-level read-only bit on committed blob
tests.setup: Commit a blob.
tests.oracle: os.stat confirms `stat.S_IWRITE` is unset (read-only mode 0o444).

tests.title: State transition STAGED to DIGESTED happens automatically on hash complete
tests.setup: Open staging stream.
tests.action: Finish writing bytes and call close().
tests.oracle: State moves STAGED -> DIGESTED immediately.

tests.title: State transition DIGESTED to VERIFIED ensures safety before commit
tests.setup: File is DIGESTED.
tests.oracle: Artifact internal state strictly transitions from DIGESTED to VERIFIED; subsequent commit API calls are unblocked and OS file locks (if any) are released.

tests.title: State transition VERIFIED to COMMITTED wraps atomic file rename
tests.setup: File is VERIFIED.
tests.oracle: os.rename executes, state enters COMMITTED.

tests.title: Forbidden transition STAGED directly to COMMITTED aborts securely
tests.setup: File is STAGED.
tests.oracle: Throws ForbiddenTransitionError. OS rename never executes.

tests.title: Idempotent retry of committed artifact returns existing record entirely from DB
tests.setup: File COMMITTED. Mock OS filesystem read methods.
tests.oracle: DB query returns success. Mock OS methods show zero reads triggered.

tests.title: Duplicate artifact upload results in single blob storage on disk
tests.setup: Upload identical payload from 5 separate requests sequentially.
tests.oracle: Raw `os.listdir` shows exactly one physical file in the artifact directory.

tests.title: Positive control for immutability: valid untouched artifact reads fine
tests.setup: Commit completely normal artifact.
tests.oracle: Reads 100% of bytes successfully without Tamper error.

tests.title: Positive control for path traversal: legitimate deep valid path succeeds
tests.setup: Reference is a valid 64-char hex digest string.
tests.oracle: Path resolves cleanly into the scoped artifact directory without raising Boundary error.

tests.title: Orphan cleanup routine correctly identifies unreferenced physical blobs
tests.setup: Create dummy valid file in artifacts directory manually.
tests.oracle: Routine deletes the dummy file since no Core stream Record points to it.

tests.title: Extension generating artifact cleanly links to ArtifactStore port
tests.setup: Mock extension emitting an artifact.
tests.action: Host routing hands artifact to ArtifactStore.
tests.oracle: Core records the reference exactly matching the emitted hash.

tests.title: Crash injected during atomic rename rolls back cleanly
tests.setup: Mock os.rename to `os._exit(1)` midway.
tests.oracle: Process dies. Upon restart, staging file exists in `.tmp`, final file does not. Orphan sweep removes `.tmp`.

tests.title: NUL byte within payload content is processed completely correctly
tests.setup: Payload contains binary `\x00` bytes internally.
tests.oracle: Hashing and OS write succeed seamlessly; no string termination truncates the file.
tests.evidence: os.stat size matches exact binary length

tests.title: Empty 0-byte artifact processes as a valid legitimate file
tests.setup: Stage completely empty string/bytes.
tests.oracle: Succeeds. Digest equals SHA256 of empty string (e3b0c44298fc1c14...). File size is 0 bytes.

tests.title: Read stream blocks or handles concurrent deletion via open file handle safety
tests.setup: Open file for streaming read. While open, trigger GC/delete in separate thread.
tests.oracle: Windows OS lock prevents deletion of open file, OR Linux inode retention allows read to finish seamlessly. Result: read succeeds.

tests.title: Exception terminal disposition handles missing physical blob gracefully
tests.setup: Core references valid digest. File deleted manually from disk.
tests.action: Attempt to read artifact via Core.
tests.oracle: Throws explicitly typed ArtifactNotFoundError instead of raw OS FileNotFoundError. State logs warning, does not crash.

tests.title: Corrupted DB metadata still allows blob read if payload hash strictly verifies
tests.setup: Delete ArtifactStore local metadata row. File remains on disk.
tests.oracle: Store recovers by hashing physical file on demand; matches requested digest, succeeds.

tests.title: Missing artifact reference structurally raises domain error
tests.setup: Provide invalid digest format.
tests.oracle: Throws explicit InvalidArtifactReferenceError without touching the file system or executing any OS-level path resolution, returning structurally safe failure.
